name: MicroSlate
summary: A dedicated writing machine with Bluetooth keyboard support, microSD auto-save, and Wi-Fi note sharing and cloud sync.
description: Turn your Sticky into a dedicated writing machine with Bluetooth keyboard support, letting you type distraction-free while auto-saving to microSD, and syncing notes to phones, OneDrive, Google Drive, or Dropbox over Wi-Fi.

compatibility.notes: Requires a Bluetooth LE keyboard and a microSD card. Wi-Fi is needed for note transfers and optional cloud sync. Version 3.0.2 was flashed and tested successfully on reTerminal Sticky by the Seeed contributor.

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge. Back up device data before installing.

notes.title: Keyboard and storage
notes.description: Insert a microSD card and pair a Bluetooth LE keyboard in Settings to start writing.

notes.title: Optional sync
notes.description: Use Wi-Fi to transfer notes to a phone or sync with OneDrive, Google Drive, or Dropbox. Cloud sync requires an account with the selected provider.
